#MeToo — it was always going to end in tears

Janet Albrechtsen The Australian July 10, 2019

Never have so-called progressives been more manifestly regressive than in the way the #MeToo movement undermines fundamental legal rights https://t.co/EmYTQjiIp1

In the early days of the #MeToo movement, women sought solidarity by sharing experiences of sexual abuse online. In the dying days of the movement, women sought publicity by holding famous men guilty without charge.
